stepExplanation: First, find parallel combination: 1/Rp = 1/6 + 1/3 = 1/6 + 2/6 = 3/6 = 1/2, so Rp = 2 ohm. Then total resistance: Rtotal = Rp + R3 = 2 + 8 = 10 ohm.
stepBody: First calculate the equivalent resistance of R1 and R2 in parallel using 1/Rp = 1/R1 + 1/R2, then add R3 in series. What is the total resistance?
